title: Scorpio, you were just in shallow water
caption: for the scorpios who read this twice

scenes.text: scorpio, i know you're already reading between these lines.
pluto rules you. you were made in the deep part of the water.
you skip the small talk and wait for the hour where it gets real.
you'll know their whole story before they learn your middle name.
it isn't coldness. it's how you keep the soft things alive.
but a locked door keeps out the ones who would have stayed, too.
and when it ends, you leave a window open, just to watch.
you're the sign of the phoenix. you know how to burn and return.
so let it burn clean this time. release it. don't haunt it.
the right one won't pry. they'll wait at the water's edge.
let them read your sky long before they ever see your face.
you were never too much, scorpio. you were just in shallow water.
rest now. the deep will keep until morning.
